ValidationRule.description: Does not allow the follow up date to be added in the past.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.Name = "NAS General Support Case", $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'IM_Custom Sys Admin', $Profile.Name <> 'IME_Custom Sys Admin', Follow_up_Date__c < NOW(), ISPICKVAL(NAS_Root_Cause_Reason__c, ""), or( ISPICKVAL(Status, "On Hold - Internal"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "On Hold - Customer"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "In Progress") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please set Follow Up Date to a future date.
